Corporate FX Sales Associate — Harborline Capital Markets (London, hybrid)

Harborline's corporate treasury desk helps mid-market UK businesses manage currency
risk on cross-border trade. We are hiring an associate to build and own a book of
corporate clients from first contact through to first trade and beyond.

What you will do
- Originate new corporate relationships through outbound prospecting, referrals and
  networking across importers, exporters and PE-backed portfolio companies.
- Qualify hedging requirements: exposure, settlement cycles, payment corridors and
  counterparty risk appetite.
- Work with the trading desk to structure spot, forward and options solutions, and
  explain them clearly to finance directors who are not FX specialists.
- Maintain accurate pipeline and activity records in the CRM; hit weekly outbound
  and meeting targets.
- Keep on top of macro and currency market developments and share a daily view with
  clients.

What we are looking for
- Demonstrable outbound sales or business development experience, ideally in FX,
  payments or financial services.
- Comfort with high call volumes and a long-cycle, relationship-led sales motion.
- Commercial judgement, regulatory awareness and a genuine interest in global markets.
- Track record of hitting revenue targets in a regulated environment.
